title: The logo for the first Emirati mission to the International Space Station ISS has been revealed, the design reflects the creativity of the UAE’s youth
excerpt: Astronaut Hazzaa Al Mansoori will take off on Wednesday September 25 carrying the design, which reflects the creativity of the country’s youth. The logo was designed in collaboration with the Federal Youth Authority.…
body:
Astronaut Hazzaa Al Mansoori will take off on Wednesday September 25 carrying the design, which reflects the creativity of the country’s youth.

The logo was designed in collaboration with the Federal Youth Authority.
